It is a name of respect and reverence for the Prophet Muhammad, who is considered the last messenger of God in Islam. The name Muhammadun carries the meaning “Belonging to Muhammad” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Muhammadun usually hope their child will grow to embody belonging to muhammad and live with faith, good character and purpose.
